snippet.title: Morinaga Pac-Man Mini (HTML5) - Normal Maze Gameplay
snippet.description:
Morinaga Pac-Man Mini is a 2020 advergame cross-promoting Pac-Man and the Morinaga line of Japanese snack products. Rather than turn blue, the ghosts can turn into a wide variety of foods depending on their color and the flavor being used as a Power Pellet.

If you would like to play this one for yourself, you can do so here:
https://web.archive.org/web/20200311114228/https://www.morinaga.co.jp/hi-chew/pac-man_mini/game/
